description:
Search notes and logs, and summarise thread activity. Returns pointers (absolute paths plus metadata), never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a time window (notes, logs and hours)
  overview THREAD [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread T] [--kind K,...] [--text S] [--today] [--reverse] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record, merged into one chronology

Args:
  THREAD, T: a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink.
  D: YYYY-MM-DD. --since and --until are inclusive.

Flags:
  notes:
    --type  note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text  case-insensitive literal, matched over topic and body
    --limit  default 20; 0 for all
  logs:
    --text  case-insensitive literal, matched over entry lines
    --limit  default 20; 0 for all
  activity:
    --thread  limit to one thread
  overview:
    --limit  recent items listed (default 5; 0 for all)
  stream:
    --kind  comma-separated, from: note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending. Default: all
    --text  case-insensitive literal, matched over thread and summary
    --today  same as setting --since and --until to today
    --reverse  oldest first (default is newest first)
    --limit  default 100; 0 for all
  all subcommands: --json  JSON output

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["overview", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "note,log,hours"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-10-01", "--until", "2026-10-31"]

Notes:
  Read-only.
  Output paths are absolute. Pass them straight to a reader.
  Dates are event dates: a note's frontmatter timestamp, not its filename.
  Hours descriptions are not searchable by --text.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
